summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude Segal AmeriCorps educational awards from gross income, meaning recipients would not pay federal taxes on these awards or on student loan debt paid with these awards.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude AmeriCorps educational awards from gross income and from the discharge of student loan debt. This directly reduces the tax burden on recipients of these awards, thus lowering taxes for a specific group.
The bill creates a new tax exclusion for AmeriCorps educational awards and related student-loan discharges, directly reducing federal revenue and thereby widening the deficit to provide this benefit.
